cafe.name: THE Cafe
cafe.kicker: Good coffee · Great food · Higher ground
cafe.headline: Slow down.
cafe.intro: Custom-roasted coffee, Darjeeling tea, matcha, Himalayan comfort food and global favourites — made for lingering a little longer.
cafe.address: Salbari, Springdale Complex, Above Glenarys, opposite Union Bank, Darjeeling – 734002
cafe.aboutBeans: We source from the best and oldest estates in India and around the globe, working directly with farmers to create our own coffee — customized in our roast profile and blends, with a cup score above 86 — so you get the highest quality of specialty coffee possible.

closing.line1: In a world of fast food,
closing.line2: Thank you for slowing down with us.

eventsIntro: Cuppings, classes and slow evenings. Seats are limited — register and we'll hold yours.

sections.title: Coffee
sections.intro: Custom blends and premium single-origin coffee, custom roasted, crafted from slow manual brews to refined Italian espresso classics.

items.name: Manual Brews — Pourover & Others
items.desc: Single-origin specialty coffee brewed to order using V60 pourover, moka pot, French press, or AeroPress — highlighting clarity and origin character. Ask us about the bean options.

items.name: Latte / Flat White / Cappuccino
items.desc: Smooth espresso with steamed milk and a layer of foam.

items.name: Cranberry Coffee
items.desc: Double shot espresso paired with cranberry juice. Hot or iced.

items.name: Espresso / Ristretto / Doppio
items.desc: A bold, concentrated shot with deep aroma and crema.

items.name: Americano
items.desc: Espresso softened with hot water for a clean, smooth cup. Hot or iced.

items.name: House Cold Coffee
items.desc: Chilled coffee blended with ice cream — smooth, creamy, indulgent.

items.name: Espresso Sunrise / Sunset
items.desc: A layered twist of zesty juice topped with a double shot of espresso.

items.name: Cold Brew
items.desc: Slow-steeped for 18+ hours for a smooth, low-acidity cup. Top it up with milk.

items.name: Affogato
items.desc: A scoop of ice cream drowned in a hot shot of espresso.

items.name: Coconut Coffee Cloud
items.desc: Light and tropical — coconut water layered with rich, foamy premium coffee.

items.name: Espresso Bomb
items.desc: A concentrated double shot layered over vanilla ice cream, finished with a dusting of cocoa — dessert and coffee in one glass.

items.name: Beverage Add-ons
items.desc: Hazelnut, caramel, or honey syrup ₹50 · decaf option ₹80 · vegan milk (almond, oat) ₹80

sections.title: Tea Bar & Matcha
sections.intro: Loose leaf teas served cup or pot, and stone-ground ceremonial grade Japanese matcha.

items.name: Silver Needle White Tea
items.desc: Handpicked tender buds — silky, delicate, and naturally sweet. High in antioxidants, low in caffeine. The true luxury of teas.

items.name: Darjeeling First Flush
items.desc: The prized first harvest of Darjeeling — light, floral, and elegantly brisk. Ask our hostess about the selections.

items.name: Earl Grey
items.desc: A timeless tea infused with bergamot — fragrant, bright, and refined.

items.name: Unique Blue Tea
items.desc: With aromatic spices — a soothing floral infusion with a striking natural hue and a calm, lingering finish.

items.name: Herbal & Green Tea Selection
items.desc: Lemongrass, hibiscus, chamomile, anti-stress lavender green tea, lemon honey ginger tea, oolong, and more. Ask your server for today's selection.

items.name: Matcha Latte
items.desc: Stone-ground matcha blended with milk for an earthy finish. Hot or iced.

items.name: Dirty Matcha Latte
items.desc: A refreshing fusion of matcha and coffee with milk and ice.

items.name: Coconut Matcha Cloud
items.desc: Light and refreshing coconut water with freshly whisked matcha.

items.name: Matcha Sunrise
items.desc: Vibrant layers of matcha and orange — bright, refreshing, captivating.

items.name: Signature Matcha Cloud
items.desc: Creamy matcha layered with vibrant fruit — earthy, smooth, and refreshing.

sections.title: Coolers
sections.intro: Chilled, handcrafted signature blends to beat the heat and keep you feeling light.

items.name: Fresh Lime Soda

items.name: Local House Noodles
